question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A person who renounces a religious or political belief or principle.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"apostate"** means a person who renounces a religious or political belief or principle. (धर्मत्यागी)

 
 
• **Example:** After years of being a devout follower, he became an **apostate** and left the religious community.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Agnostic** (अज्ञेयवादी): A person who believes that nothing is known or can be known of the existence or nature of God.

 
 
• **Example:** He identifies as an agnostic because he believes that the existence of God cannot be proven or disproven.
 
 
 
• **Ascetic** (संयमी): A person who practices severe self-discipline and abstention from all forms of indulgence, typically for religious reasons.
 
 
• **Example:** The monk led an ascetic life, abstaining from all comforts and luxuries.
 
 
 
• **Atheist** (नास्तिक): A person who disbelieves or lacks belief in the existence of God or gods.
 
 
• **Example:** She is an atheist who does not believe in the existence of any deity.
